title: Integrate image-blaster as a project-isolated Reference Scene Accelerator
objective: Pin image-blaster, expose bounded KHOSAN setup/doctor/run adapters, keep generated artifacts inside the active game project, and prevent accidental paid provider calls.
acceptance_criteria: image-blaster source is pinned to an exact commit in external-tools.lock.json
Tool Registry records image-blaster as P0 evaluate under 04 Asset Synthesizer
Setup scripts install/pin source without creating provider credentials
Doctor reports source pin, expected scripts, provider credential presence, ffmpeg/ffprobe and optional Bun
Bounded adapter writes generated state under <project>/assets/generated/image-blaster rather than the external source checkout
Potentially paid generation actions require explicit --allow-paid
Source verification and manual CI syntax checks include the new adapter
Integration documentation explains routing boundaries, costs, licenses and ADOPT fixture gates
verification: GitHub diff review of all integration files
JSON.parse succeeds for package.json and config/external-tools.lock.json
Fresh target-PC setup-image-blaster then npm run doctor:image-blaster
Paid fixture generation only after explicit owner cost approval
human_gates: External paid-provider fixture requires explicit cost approval before execution
risks: World Labs and FAL are external paid/network dependencies
Generated geometry and Gaussian splats require downstream collision/LOD/material/performance QA
Runtime fixture cannot be accepted until provider keys are configured on the target machine
notes: Source integration is being installed now; status remains verify until deterministic checks and a real provider fixture pass.
